note: Telenav (TNAV, Nasdaq), location-based services; IPO 2010, V99 took it private in 2021, which retires the standalone mark. The firm's own Milestones say 'Partnered, Series E' in 2006 — a Growth entry — against a band that read Seed off a 2012 $3.6M filing six years later.
Tenor, the GIF keyboard; Google acquired it in 2018. Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2015 (firm's own page).
The Black Tux, formalwear rental; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2014 (firm's own page).
Trigo, computer vision for checkout-free retail; a REST-only listing with no milestone. Israeli company. Entry round not established.
Trove AI, a 2026 REST-only listing with no description or milestone. Entry round not established.
True Anomaly, space security hardware and software; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2023 (firm's own page). Last primary above $1B on the 2025 Series C.
TruEra, AI quality and observability; Snowflake acquired it in 2024. Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2021 (firm's own page).
Truework, income and employment verification; a REST-only listing with no milestone. Entry round not established.
Tumblr; Yahoo acquired it in 2013 for $1.1B and Automattic bought it on in 2019. The firm's own Milestones say 'Partnered, Series E' in 2011 — a Growth entry at scale.

Turing, AI training data and talent; Menlo partnered at the Series E in 2025 (firm's own page). The 'acquired' pre-fill is a namesake collision — Turing is a live private company that raised $111M in 2025.
Typeface, enterprise generative content; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2023 (firm's own page).

Uber: Menlo led the $32M Series B in December 2011 with Shervin Pishevar taking the board observer seat — the single most consequential position in the firm's book. NYSE IPO 2019 (UBER). A public $1B+ row: the cited market cap is owed by the A/B pass. The Wikidata NL country pre-fill is a namesake collision.
Unagi Scooters, electric scooter subscriptions; on the job board but not on the portfolio listing. Entry round not established.
Unravel Data, DataOps performance intelligence; the firm's own page marks the entry Series A 2015, against a band that read Seed off the 2016-2019 filings.
Unstructured, document preprocessing for LLMs; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2024 (firm's own page).
UpCounsel, on-demand legal marketplace; wound down in 2020 and was bought out of the shutdown by Enduring Ventures. Form D 2018 $12.0M with Venky Ganesan.
Upstart (UPST, Nasdaq), AI lending marketplace; IPO 2020. A REST-only historical listing with no milestone; Menlo's entry is an early-2010s position and the round is not established.
Usermind, business operations orchestration; Qualtrics acquired it in 2021. Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2015 (firm's own page).

UUNET, the first commercial internet service provider; MFS acquired it in 1996, then WorldCom, and the brand was retired inside Verizon Business in 2006. The row is acquired, not defunct: the business continued inside its acquirers (COLLECTION.md 6). A 1993-94 Menlo position, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
Valid Logic Systems, electronic design automation; Cadence Design Systems acquired it in 1991. A 1981-83 Menlo position on the 1998 software page, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
Vareto, strategic finance planning; Menlo partnered at the seed in 2020 (firm's own page).
Veriflow, formal verification for networks; VMware acquired it in 2019. Form D 2016 $8.2M with Matt Murphy.

Vidyo, video conferencing infrastructure; Enghouse Systems acquired it in 2019. AVERY MORE, a Menlo venture partner, is on the Form Ds — but so is DOUG CARLISLE, which is the Menlo seat and what makes this a member rather than the venture partner's own book (the trap set's Vidyo case).
Vilya, macrocycle drug design; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2023 (firm's own page).
Vivun, AI for presales; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2020 (firm's own page).
Vixel Corporation, Fibre Channel switches; NASDAQ IPO 1999, Emulex acquired it in 2003. A mid-1990s Menlo position on the 1998 communications page, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.

VNUS Medical Technologies, radiofrequency treatment for venous reflux; NASDAQ IPO 2004, Covidien acquired it in 2009 for $440M. Recovered from the LOGO-ONLY row on the 1998 medical page and corroborated by Menlo fund Section 16 filings. Pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.

Voltage Security, format-preserving encryption; HP acquired it in 2015. First listed 2004, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy — the band's 'Pre-Seed' rides a 2014 $625k filing ten years after the entry.

Warby Parker (WRBY, NYSE), direct-to-consumer eyewear; direct listing 2021. MENLO PARTICIPATED IN THE $12M SERIES A of September 2011 — the site's own Milestones say 'Series B' for the same 2011 year, contradicting themselves, and this is the single miss in the calibration gate (golden.json). A public $1B+ row: the cited market cap is owed by the A/B pass.
Whisper Aero, quiet electric propulsion; the firm's own page marks the entry Seed 2021, against a band that read Growth off the 2023 $41.4M filing.
Wispr Flow, voice dictation; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2025 (firm's own page). Wikipedia's article on the company names Menlo as the Series A lead.
WorkUp, a 2023 REST-only listing with no description or milestone. Entry round not established.

Xaira Therapeutics, AI-native drug discovery; the firm's own Milestones read 'Partnered, Seed + Series A' in 2024 — Menlo was in the $1B launch financing at inception, so the entry is recorded as Seed. Last primary $1B+ at launch.
Yellowbrick Data, enterprise data warehouse; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2015 (firm's own page).
YuMe (YUME, NYSE), video advertising; IPO 2013, RhythmOne acquired it in 2018, which retires the standalone mark. Form D 2011-2012 with Shawn Carolan dates the Series A entry.
Yuzu Health, health plan administration; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2025 (firm's own page).
Zafran Security, threat exposure management; Menlo led the Series C in 2025 (firm's own page and its own announcement post). Israeli company.
Zylo, SaaS management; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2019 (firm's own page); the band read Growth off the 2019-2023 filings, which agrees.
3PARdata is 3PAR under its founding name — the 2004-2007 listings carry it, the 2009+ listings carry '3PAR'. Duplicate of '3par', canonical there; HP acquired the company in 2010.
A4Vision, 3D facial recognition; Bioscrypt acquired it in 2007 and L-1 Identity Solutions bought that on. First listed 2005, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
AcceLight Networks, optical switching; wound down in 2002 after the telecom collapse. A 2000 listing, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
Adomo, unified messaging appliances; Mitel acquired its assets in 2009. First listed 2004, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.

ADVA Optical Networking, optical transport; Adtran took majority control in 2022. German company, Frankfurt-listed. A listing-only row from 2009-2012 with no Menlo filing: Menlo's position is in a predecessor or an early round and the entry round is not established.
Akonix Systems, instant-messaging security; Quest Software acquired it in 2008. First listed 2004, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
All Hands AI is the company behind OpenHands; the base carries both names. Menlo partnered at the seed in 2024 (the firm's own page for OpenHands AI). Duplicate of 'openhands-ai', canonical there.
